description: Configured-store domain availability, suggestions, pricing, configuration, enablement, checkout URLs and supported TLDs.

notes.text: All six operations require the domain_recommendation feature. Supplied strings retain their bytes and are encoded once; optional null inputs omit, while false, zero and empty strings stay supplied. No local domain, IDN, TLD, enum or range normalization. One request only; no implicit cache, fallback, pagination, store lookup, merge, retry, rollback or returned-URL fetch. Live and configured-store behavior remain unverified under whm-api-client-8x0.2.68.

Available from cPanel 134. The source expects an FQDN including TLD. The server caches availability per domain. Explicit null availability is preserved without inferring its reason. Availability, premium and TLD flags remain strict native booleans; suggestion premium boolean compatibility does not apply here. Its nullable premium_cost_pricing remains opaque; no sibling premium structure is inferred.

The server caches results for up to two minutes. Omitted useCache retains server default 1; explicit false bypasses server cache and may contact the configured store. The client adds no cache. Availability and price are not guaranteed at actual checkout.

Currency code, display_value, prefix, suffix and value stay exact strings, including formatting and whitespace. PricingPeriod fields are optional; null, empty price objects and omission remain distinct. No currency conversion, parsing, rounding or float coercion.

evidence.note: Selected formal GET variant and ordinary Flag outcome; no response or requiredness correction. x-readonly=true retains effective GET.

Page numbers are one-based; omitted page/pageSize retain store defaults. Pinned documentation omits a TLD input despite cache-key prose. This source-only finding does not add a typed argument or hidden parameter; the pinned interface stays unchanged under whm-api-client-8x0.2.68.

Returned domain and registration-term keys remain dynamic; empty maps are valid. Metadata permits unknown members. Every suggestion row requires pricing, integer 0|1 is_premium and nullable premium_cost_pricing. Only is_premium additionally accepts native false/true and normalizes to 0/1, based on reviewed 11.138.0.19 injection and serializer evidence. Optional is_searched_term is a strict native integer 0|1 identifying the injected own-search row when 1; ordinary rows can omit it. No string, float or null flag conversion. Formal requiredness is retained despite prose calling premium details optional; omission remains a visible mismatch pending evidence. No conditional premium-field inference. Actual configured-store success remains unobserved.

Available from cPanel 138. The source expects an FQDN including TLD and a registration period in years. Returns a private checkout URL for caller-controlled use. The method does not fetch the URL, navigate, register a domain, make payment or establish ownership.

Selected formal GET is classified x-readonly=false with x-rollback=none, so mutation policy uses form POST. No retries or rollback. Live POST acceptance is unverified: a server accepting only documented GET can fail until route-specific evidence resolves transport. Returning a checkout URL does not prove completion of a commercial transaction.

Reviewed 11.138.0.19 source creates a real upstream store cart, adds a domain item and requests checkout after refusing an unavailable domain. The backend emits Domain-Purchase-Initiated analytics with the domain by default; analytics can precede cart validation and occur despite a later failure. This is source-only evidence, not transaction or route verification. Do not assume atomicity or retry automatically. No skip_backend_track input is added. purchaseDomain was never called: the reviewer permission check refused it and no alternate route or retry was attempted; live POST/store/cart/analytics behavior remains unobserved.
